services.name: Surf Shack
services.desc: We have large variety of surfboards ranging from 9ft foam tops to Libtech shortboards. We will swap your board out for free so you can always try something new or if the waves change. We rent only Excel wetsuits. We have 5/4’s in all sizes. Suits range in size from 35 lbs children up to 260 lbs adults. In colder months you can add a hooded thermal rash guard and be warm enough - even in the snow. We are a 5 minute drive from Wickaninnish Beach (South Long Beach) one of the best local beaches for summer swell.
